name: SOLUTN
recent: Solution Group 在 2026 年 10 月出现股权变动：Calvin Lau 成为新的大股东，而 Datuk Freddy Lim 出售 2400 万股后不再是大股东。公司也披露了重大诉讼，并将财政年度结束日变更。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收同比增长近一倍，但净利转亏。
notable: Calvin Lau 成为公司新的大股东。
Datuk Freddy Lim 出售 2400 万股后不再是大股东。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 10.961 million，环比增长 26.1%，同比增长 99.6%；净亏损 MYR 0.128 million，净利率 -1.2%，而上一季度净利率为 2.9%。

recent_en: Solution Group saw shareholding changes in October 2026: Calvin Lau became a new substantial shareholder while Datuk Freddy Lim ceased to be one after selling 24 million shares. The company also disclosed material litigation and changed its financial year end. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue nearly doubled year-on-year but the company swung to a net loss.
notable_en: Calvin Lau became a new substantial shareholder of the company.
Datuk Freddy Lim ceased to be a substantial shareholder after selling 24 million shares.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation.
The latest quarter swung to a net loss.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 10.961 million, up 26.1% QoQ and 99.6% YoY; net loss was MYR 0.128 million with a net margin of -1.2%, compared to a net margin of 2.9% in the previous quarter.
